model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram is a nested pie chart that compares the categories of characters, with the outer ring representing virtual characters and the inner circle distinguishing between virtual and real characters. The chart is divided into a total of 9 sectors. The outer ring is segmented into 5 categories: Game Characters, Novel Characters, Teleplay Characters, Movie Characters, and Comic Characters, all colored in various shades of blue and together making up approximately 80% of the chart. The inner circle is divided into 3 main categories: Virtual Characters in blue, making up about 55%, Custom Characters in pink, making up around 20%, and Real Characters in green, making up roughly 25%. The Real Characters category is further subdivided into 7 subcategories: Influencers, Actors, Musicians, Writers, Athletes, Artists, and Scientists. The diagram includes labels for each sector and subcategory, but does not include a legend or percentage labels within the sectors. The sectors are arranged in a visually distinct manner, with the Virtual Characters and Real Characters categories being prominent in the inner circle.
model_annotations.English: This chart is a nested pie chart comparing the distribution of character types across different categories. The chart is divided into three main slices and several sub-slices, with a total of three main categories and multiple subcategories. The largest slice, labeled "Virtual Characters" and colored light blue, occupies roughly half of the chart and is further divided into five subcategories: "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", and "Game Characters". The second-largest slice, labeled "Custom Characters" and colored pink, takes up approximately a quarter of the chart and overlaps with the "Real Characters" category. The smallest slice, labeled "Real Characters" and colored green, occupies around a quarter of the chart and is further divided into seven subcategories: "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers". The chart does not include a traditional legend, but the labels are placed directly on or adjacent to their respective slices, and the slices are visually distinguishable by color. The subcategories are arranged in a clockwise direction around their respective main categories, with no apparent ordering by size.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm vergleicht die Kategorien 'Virtual Characters' und 'Real Characters'. Es gibt insgesamt 10 Segmente, die in drei Farben gruppiert sind: blau, grün und rosa. Die blaue Gruppe macht den größten Anteil aus und enthält fünf Segmente, die sich auf verschiedene Arten von virtuellen Charakteren beziehen, nämlich 'Game Characters', 'Novel Characters', 'Teleplay Characters', 'Movie Characters' und 'Comic Characters', die zusammen etwa 70 % des Diagramms einnehmen. Das innerste blaue Segment ist mit 'Virtual Characters' beschriftet. Die grüne Gruppe befindet sich innerhalb des rosa Segments und enthält sieben Segmente, die sich auf verschiedene Berufe beziehen, nämlich 'Influencers', 'Actors', 'Musicians', 'Writers', 'Athletes', 'Artists' und 'Scientists'. Das innere rosa Segment ist mit 'Custom Characters' und das innere grüne Segment mit 'Real Characters' beschriftet. Das Diagramm enthält keine Prozentsätze oder eine Legende, und die Segmente sind nach ihrer Zugehörigkeit gruppiert. Die äußeren Segmente sind im Uhrzeigersinn angeordnet, beginnend bei 'Comic Characters' und endend bei 'Game Characters'.
